text:
Maya Chen: getting alerts for high OOMs from the eu-west GPU pool, service errors rising. GLB shows increased latency to eu-west backends. infra-gpu-degraded alert fired. @oncall-bot please ack.

oncall-bot: incident acknowledged and paged Nate (infra).

Nate (infra): I'm on it — looking at node evictions and driver restarts in eu-west-3. Several GPUs reporting `NVML_ERROR_LOST_CONTEXT`. Suspect a rack-level power blip earlier.

Jordan Patel: can we shift a slice of traffic off eu-west to avoid user-facing errors? Prefer graceful shift so na pools don't get hammered.

Maya Chen: +1. Plan: dynamic route override to reduce eu-west weight to ~35% while increasing na-west/na-east proportionally, enable cache warmup on targets. Keep move gradual over ~5 mins.

Azra (eng-runtime): agree on gradual. If we bump too fast na-west will see cache churn and token cost spike. Recommend 20% per minute.

Nate (infra): executing override now: `glbctl override add --service inference --region eu-west --weight-mult 0.35 --reason "eu-west gpu instability"` then `glbctl override add --service inference --region na-west --weight-mult 1.2`.

deploy-bot: command received: `glbctl override` run by Nate. tracking_id=54f2. propagation ~30s.

Jordan Patel: I'll queue a fast scale on na-west dedicated pools: `infractl scale --pool na-west-gpu --add 2` to give headroom for warmup.

Nate (infra): scale accepted; instances provisioning (image pull + kube join). ETA ~4m.

Maya Chen: watch metrics — eu-west errors dropping 12% -> 3% since override. p95 latency improving. Good so far.

Liam O'Neill: note: prefix cache hit-rate on na-west dipped to ~20% after initial shift, expecting warmup. Cold start token cost up ~35% for the moment.

Azra (eng-runtime): enabling aggressive prewarm on na-west for 15m to mitigate cold token cost: `runtimectl prewarm --service inference --duration 15m --parallel 8`.

Jordan Patel: cost impact FYI — extra nodes + prewarm will add ~¤1.8k/hr while active. We'll absorb for incident window and then revert.

Nate (infra): eu-west node restarts finished; eviction rate decreasing. Starting controlled rollback plan. Will remove override 54f2 after a health pass.

Maya Chen: can infra run driver health sweep and restart any pods pinned to high-memory model variants before full rollback? Want to avoid re-triggering evictions.

Nate (infra): executing: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu` then `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-drivers`. Also truncating heavy models by moving some traffic to lower-memory variants.

Azra (eng-runtime): attaching an SLO monitor — alert if error rate >5% or latency p95 increases x2 during the next hour.

deploy-bot: override 54f2 removed by Nate at 1795002550.

Maya Chen: eu-west error rates back to baseline, latency stable. Approved: revert prewarm and remove extra nodes once deprovision finishes. Jordan, can you deprovision the added capacity?

Jordan Patel: `infractl scale --pool na-west-gpu --remove 2` issued, deprovision ETA ~6m.

Liam O'Neill: quick post-incident note: probable root cause = UPS switchover in rack 3 causing driver flakiness and evictions. Nate to open colo ops ticket with logs.

Maya Chen: thanks all. We'll draft a short incident note for PM/CS and follow up on the colo ticket. :thumbsup:
